import cv2, numpy as np
im=cv2.imread('first_frame.png')[:,:,::-1]
# quantize and kmeans on sampled pixels
small=cv2.resize(im,(320,180),interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
Z=small.reshape(-1,3).astype(np.float32)
crit=(cv2.TERM_CRITERIA_EPS+cv2.TERM_CRITERIA_MAX_ITER,50,0.5)
K=16
_,lab,cent=cv2.kmeans(Z,K,None,crit,10,cv2.KMEANS_PP_CENTERS)
cent=np.uint8(cent)
counts=np.bincount(lab.ravel(),minlength=K)
order=np.argsort(-counts)
for k in order:
 mask=(lab.reshape(small.shape[:2])==k)
 ys,xs=np.where(mask)
 print(f'{counts[k]/len(lab):6.2%} rgb={cent[k].tolist()} bbox x{4*xs.min()}-{4*xs.max()} y{4*ys.min()}-{4*ys.max()}')
PY"
